_doc: Rival aces: Halden-Voss Security's named pilots. Each flies a real Mech Kit build (part ids from mechkit/data/parts.json; weapons [left arm, right arm, left shoulder, right shoulder] — projectile weapons only: rifles, guns, shotguns, missile pods, grenade launchers, mortars) under the same movement rules as the player (boost, quick boost, jump + hover, energy, heat). paint = the frame's colours. ai = personality: range (tiles it likes to fight at), aggression (0..1, how hard it closes in), strafe (0..1, how much it circles), dodge (0..1, chance to quick-boost out of a shot coming at it), accuracy (0..1), boostFloor (energy share it keeps in reserve), heatLimit (heat share it stops firing at), jump (jumps per minute). hp = its armour (a duel, not a pop: an ace takes a minute or two of good shooting); dmgMul scales its weapons' damage against a player's (it fires as often as a player, every hit hurts less). lines = comms taunts (spoken as 'ace:<id>' with its own frame as the picture): in (arrives), taunt (now and then), hurt (below half armour), win (a player goes down), down (beaten). Missions use an ace as the enemy kind 'ace:<id>' in waves or 'kill' objectives.

aces.name: Vesna Krall
aces.blurb: Halden-Voss's breach specialist. Closes the distance behind a gatling and finishes it with a shotgun.

in: Sawtooth on your channel. This district's under Halden-Voss protection. Walk away.
You're the freelancer they keep paying? Let's see what you're worth up close.
taunt: You fight like a contractor. Paid by the hour.
win: One less freelancer on the board.
down: Systems red — Sawtooth's out. This isn't over.
Pulling out! Someone get me a recovery team!

aces.name: Idony Marsh
aces.blurb: A duellist on light legs. Keeps her distance, dodges everything she sees coming and punishes you from range.

in: This is Lancet. I've watched your last three drops. You lean left when you dodge.
Halden-Voss asked me to make an example. Hold still.
taunt: Every shot you miss, I'm counting.
hurt: That one cost me paint. Now it costs you.
win: Lancet to command: target is down.
down: Lancet, disengaging. Next time I won't hold back.
Eject, eject — mark this one, command.

aces.name: Corvin Achterberg
aces.blurb: A scrap-built frame held together by spite. Fills the air with rockets and bolts from the middle distance.

in: Jackdaw here. Halden-Voss pays me per frame I scrap. Smile.
Ooh, shiny. I'll be wearing your arms by tonight.
taunt: Rockets are cheap, friend. I've got crates of 'em.
Hold still, I'm trying to read your serial number.
hurt: Ha! It's fine, it was like that when I found it.
down: Bah! Pulling back — keep the change!
Jackdaw's grounded. Somebody owes me a frame.

_grunts: Round 5: Halden-Voss line frames — rank-and-file enemy mechs on the same machinery as the aces (sim/ace.js aceKinds), at grunt level. Enemy kind = the id itself (use it in waves like any kind). max = how many of that kind may be alive at once; no comms lines, no ace bar, weaker ai (dodge, accuracy, lead = how far ahead of a moving frame it aims, 0..1); beaten = a wreck blast and loot like an elite.

grunts.name: Striker
grunts.blurb: Halden-Voss's light line frame: quick on two legs, a pulse gun and a rifle. Comes in pairs.

grunts.name: Warden
grunts.blurb: Halden-Voss's heavy line frame: slow, thick armour, a rifle and a shoulder of missiles.
